style.backgroundSystem: only three background planes across the whole set: a seamless cool mist-white studio field #EEF4F6, a deep teal field #0B7C93 and a pale blue-grey panel #D8E5EA, one dominant plane per screen with at most one hard horizontal edge where a wall plane meets a counter plane; no gradient mesh, no sky, no marble, no botanical or leaf shadow cut-outs, no warm wood backdrop, no dark low-key clinic room, no landscape scenery
